title: 思维链何时有效何时有害：LLM推理中串行深度瓶颈的实证研究
summary: 本研究通过H_dp带宽约束框架，实证考察思维链（CoT）对LLM推理的影响。发现CoT并非普遍提升推理能力，而是作为带宽旁路：对高串行深度任务（如GSM8K、MATH）显著提升（+54至+68个百分点），对浅层任务（如MMLU、ARC）冗余，对中等任务（HumanEval）效果依赖模型规模。
summary_en: This study empirically investigates chain-of-thought (CoT) effects on LLM reasoning via the H_dp bandwidth bound. CoT acts as a bandwidth bypass: it significantly helps high serial-depth tasks (GSM8K, MATH: +54 to +68 pp), is redundant for shallow tasks (MMLU, ARC), and shows model-size-dependent effects on intermediate tasks (HumanEval).
